mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name FROM Comments c LEFT JOIN Users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name FROM Comments c LEFT JOIN Users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Comments (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name, p.title AS post_title, COUNT(cr.report_id) AS report_count FROM Comments c JOIN comment_reports cr ON cr.comment_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN Users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN Posts p ON c.post_id = p.post_id GROUP BY c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, author_name, p.title ORDER BY report_count DESC, c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name, p.title AS post_title, p.status AS post_status FROM Comments c JOIN Posts p ON c.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN Users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.user_name IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name, p.title AS post_title, p.status AS post_status FROM Comments c JOIN Posts p ON c.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN Users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND c.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Comments c JOIN Posts p ON c.post_id = p.post_id JOIN Users owner ON owner.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND c.user_id != #{userId} AND p.status = 'visible' AND (owner.last_reply_check_at IS NULL OR c.created_at > owner.last_reply_check_at)
